Some of us type things longer than a bumper sticker. This means that we end up with a lot of text written into a tiny box from time to time. This is certainly livable and nothing too major (That's what preview is for, right?) and it can be worked around but it is not the best. It is also not the best to want to, or have to, stop and adjust the number of rows that a reply or comment text entry box has. For those who do not know, you can drag an entry box to make it larger by clicking on the lower right side and dragging it down while holding the mouse button.

I admit that this is way down on the list of priorities, or should be, but it could be a fairly easy project though I suspect it would require another database entry. (Maybe static text user config files generated on creation and change.... Meh... Let's not go there yet.) So, on the scale of things this is pretty trivial. At the same time it would be fairly easy to add, I suspect.

Basically the end user, notably me, would be able to go to my account settings page and see a nifty new feature that said, "Set comment/reply box row number." Then the user could define a number or even have suggested numbers. Once set and saved all the comment and reply text entry boxes would be the newer, in my case larger, size boxes by default.

And no, by no means is this something that needs to be anywhere near the top of the list of important things to do. It is simple, affects only the user, allows greater choice, and may improve comment qualities as it is easier to see what you have already written if you're authoring a long post. Work-flow improvements are also to be considered as being able to concentrate better may produce higher quality replies. It seems a simple thing to enable with no drawbacks and a potentially quantifiable gain.

Sorry for the confusing title but it is, actually, the best way I could word it. I think this would be a beneficial feature and I suspect this would benefit more people than just myself. Then again, it might be better suited inside of AVE. I will cross-post there with something similar when I get a minute.
User defined default text entry box row numbers. (That is actually what I mean.)

Also, that is the oddest submission title I have ever authored. It is, on the other hand, exactly what I mean though it is very confusing. Being able to see only three or four lines of what I have typed is not enough for my particular use case. I may well be alone in this, it appears not, or we may be few in number...

However (and it appears that I can see four lines of text) it would be nice to have an option to have larger text entry boxes. Some of us type replies that are longer than pithy statements or bumper sticker wisdom. These replies sometimes require effort, concentration, and a desire for accuracy. Having the ability to see, as the default, more of your entered text can only help. I think it may be one of three suggestions at /v/ideasforvoat that someone will have a hard time coming up with a mythical potential issue which makes it subject to abuse. One could, of course, abuse it but they'd only be abusing themselves. I can only assume that some folks are into that.

Anyhow, again, this is really trivial and I do not think it should not be a major concern. As Voat is still in Alpha stage I'd not even suggest working on it. I'd wait until Beta or, if they go that route, an RC version before adding it, personally. While it is likely fairly trivial (a quick look suggested I could do this with a Stylish script but I have not tried and it would not be integrated at all) it is also a low priority issue. So, while it could be a nice feature I am prepared to wait patiently for it to happen and may well have other options to do so for myself.
